subject: K-12 Mathematics Curriculum Review
overview: The subcommittee reviewed the state of mathematics instruction across all grade levels, noting recent program adoptions and the disruption of the elementary review process by the pandemic. The body requested the development of a comprehensive curriculum catalog to improve budget transparency and ensure regular reviews of educational materials.

items.title: K-12 Mathematics Frameworks Presentation
items.summary: Director Khan presented an overview of the 2017 Massachusetts curriculum frameworks and the district's alignment with Common Core standards for mathematical content and practice.

items.title: Elementary Mathematics Program Status
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed the current use of the Envisions program and discussed the pause in the selection process for a new inquiry-based elementary curriculum due to COVID-19.

items.title: Middle School Program Implementation
items.summary: Director Khan detailed the 2019 adoption of the inquiry-based 'Illustrative Mathematics' program and its focus on problem-solving over procedural fluency.

items.title: High School Course Offerings and Resources
items.summary: Discussion covered core high school curriculum from Houghton Mifflin Harcourt and the recent purchase of new interactive statistics textbooks.

items.title: COVID-19 Learning Loss and Engagement
items.summary: Speakers addressed data indicating mathematics learning loss may be twice that of literacy due to the pandemic and discussed strategies for filling student knowledge gaps.

items.title: Development of a Curriculum Catalog
items.summary: The subcommittee requested the creation of a formal curriculum catalog for the mathematics department to track program expiration dates, costs, and accessibility supplements for various student populations.

items.title: Future Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The chair announced future subcommittee dates to review world languages, technology, and science curricula.
